fields.note: Deferred by agreement — no movement until BD is reorganised company-wide; team felt other priorities rank higher right now. Revisit once BD structure and the sales/consultant incentive model are decided.

fields.detail: Weighted commercial pipeline ~300k (incl. ~350k NeoGenomics still in qualification at standard weighting; AWS excluded as not yet sales-qualified). Deals close fast (~2 wks), so a thin pipeline is partly expected but uncertainty is high. New-business close rate weak — recent wins almost all existing clients (skewed by the lumpy 750k MGB); several new logos lost, hinting at value-prop misalignment. Jake to keep tracking new-vs-existing close rates and re-baseline from Apr/May to strip out Jan noise.

updates.rationale: Jake: 'the weighted pipeline amount is currently about 300k' / 'that close rate has not been as good'.

fields.detail: Jake + Jennifer ran a CBS challenge-mapping session: value-proposition alignment to market is the #1 challenge, alongside weak outbound sales and limited access to decision-makers for hypothesis testing. Core push is getting consultants — especially senior ones — to own more BD. Next steps: define value props across verticals (Nick has started), test the viability of each, and define how to engage more consulting staff in BD. Easy channel / online thought-leadership growth already tried without much success.

updates.rationale: Jennifer: 'how do we get consultants to take more ownership of BD responsibility, especially senior consultants.'

fields.detail: Map of every current AI use (and how it's used) is complete — Michelle built it. Next step (per Adrian): assess how people spend their time to identify where AI acceleration would add most value.

updates.rationale: Jennifer: 'Michelle helped make a map of every place we're currently using AI … assess how people are using their time and whether those are places that we could target for AI acceleration.'

value.title: Specialist-resource bottleneck on large projects
value.detail: One or two large projects could max out scarce, highly-technical consultants and compromise either delivery or the capacity to sign new business — even though overall utilisation is currently low. Triggered by NeoGenomics wanting more resource plus a potential large Natera engagement (via Amazon/AWS) needing significant resource for 9 months to a year. Can't train other consultants up quickly on this work. Exploring internal N2 collaboration or short-term contractors (engaged per-contract, no ongoing commitment). Adrian flagged this as a different category to the revenue/cost risks — only bites if they land the large business.

updates.rationale: Jennifer: 'one or two large projects could max out high demand resources and compromise our ability to either deliver on things we commit to or sign new business.'

value.title: Map skill-set constraints for resource planning
value.detail: Set out clearly where the specialist skill-set constraints are so SLT can see capacity against the incoming large-project demand. Michelle already doing 'resource Tetris'; aim to come back with options quickly.

updates.rationale: Scales: 'maybe setting it out for us … we can clearly see what those skill set constraints are' — Jennifer: 'Absolutely.'

value.title: Decide BioIT World 2027 booth (cancellation window)
value.detail: Provisional booth booked at this year's rate with a 30-day, no-penalty cancellation; provisional decision needed in the next couple of weeks. ROI as a lead-gen event isn't there (~10 booth scans from ~150 tier-1 target attendees, mostly existing contacts; no measurable web-traffic lift from talks). Likely reframe future presence to thought-leadership / talks rather than a booth — talks alone would do the 'we're still alive' job. Spend this year ~24k booth+extras, ~55k incl. travel (Michelle to confirm with Lauren). If de-booking, registrations for a few speakers (about half a booth's cost) could keep a talk presence.

updates.rationale: Adrian: 'your ROI conversation is going to be pretty simple... Not remotely there, is it? So reframe it.'

value.text: Alignment (BioTeam Q1) — BD-focused quarter: value-prop alignment to market is the #1 challenge (CBS mapping with Jake); push to get senior consultants owning BD. Pipeline thin (~300k weighted, AWS not yet qualified) but deals close fast; new-logo close rate weak, wins skewed to existing/MGB. BioIT World poor for lead-gen (~10 scans / 150 tier-1) — likely reframe to thought-leadership; booth decision in ~2 wks (30-day cancel; ~24k spend, ~55k incl. travel). New risk: large projects (NeoGenomics +, potential Natera 9mo-1yr via AWS) could max scarce specialists despite low overall util — Jennifer to map skill-set constraints; Michelle on 'resource Tetris'. 3 Explore projects progressing (BioStack + converging data-management workflows). Wider-staff bonus scheme deferred until BD reorganised. Financials: May back in red (base-pay rise + BioIT costs); pushing 6M stretch to claim 'stabilised'.

updates.rationale: Summary of the 10 Jun BioTeam Q1 alignment.
